annotation.title_clean: 关于开展基层医疗卫生机构医疗质量改善三年行动（2026—2028年）的通知
annotation.title_en: Notice on Launching the Three-Year Action for Medical Quality Improvement in Primary Healthcare Institutions (2026–2028)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: National Health Commission of the PRC (General Office); National Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine
annotation.summary_en: Notice from China's National Health Commission (Guo Wei Ban Ji Ceng Fa [2026] No. 4) launching a three-year action plan (2026–2028) to improve medical quality management in township health centres, community health centres and village clinics. It sets phased targets, annual self-inspection and correction, and evaluations. It does not cover AI or robotics.
key_provisions_or_claims: By end-2026, central township health centres and community health centres with 30+ beds establish medical quality management systems
By end-2027, other township and community health centres follow suit
By end-2028, a national primary-care quality management system covering village clinics and community health stations
Annual cycle: self-inspection and correction (Jan–Mar), quality improvement (Apr–Oct), annual evaluation (Nov–Dec)
Provincial health authorities draft implementation plans; medical consortium lead hospitals support oversight
